spotify.addToQueue.description: Puts a song in your Spotify queue, so it plays after the current one. Made for a !sr command. Runs "Added" when it worked and "Not added" (with %spotify.error%) when it did not.

fields.song: A song name to search for, like "bohemian rhapsody queen", or a Spotify song link. The default %rawInput% is what a viewer typed after the command.

variables.spotify.added: True when the song was added, False when not
variables.spotify.title: The name of the song that was added
variables.spotify.album: The album the song is on
variables.spotify.link: A web link to the song, handy to post in chat
variables.spotify.uri: Spotify's own code for the song (spotify:track:…)
variables.spotify.error: Why it did not work, in plain words, like "Open Spotify on a device first…". Send it in chat from the "Not added" branch.

spotify.skip.description: Skips to the next song on Spotify. Needs Spotify Premium and Spotify open on a device.

spotify.previous.description: Goes back to the previous song on Spotify. Needs Spotify Premium and Spotify open on a device.

spotify.playPause.description: Pauses Spotify, or makes it play again. Handy for a hotkey or a Stream Deck button. Needs Spotify Premium.

fields.mode: Pause, Resume (play again), or switch: pause if it plays and play if it is paused.

variables.spotify.playing: True when Spotify plays afterwards, False when it is paused

spotify.setVolume.description: Changes the volume of the device Spotify plays on. Some devices, like many phones, do not allow it. Needs Spotify Premium.

fields.volume: The new volume from 0 (silent) to 100 (loudest), like 40. You can use a variable such as %rawInput%.
